description: The main window on desktop: self-update and relaunch (UPD-001-006), the process log and its folder (LOG-008), and the Sharing settings pane for Remote Login (R-059; it fails as unavailable on Linux), and this computer's name, OS user, OS, VPN address and whether SSH answers there, to fill in Add device (R-058, R-060), and the device web views: open, place, show, step, pin, pop out and close them, read a leaf certificate and open an address in the system browser (WEB-004–008, D-9). Device web views (labels `web-<tab id>`) are named by no capability, so they have no IPC (WEB-007, D-3); keep every capability on `"webviews": ["main"]`, with no `windows` and no `remote`. The updater and process plugins are registered in release builds only, so in a debug build their permissions grant nothing. Known width: a script in the web view may pass headers, timeout, proxy and target to check, and may relaunch the app; it cannot change the key, the endpoints or the downgrade rule (WP-04b final review C-1).
